en_title: Rockstar President Sam Houser Issues Rare Statement to Celebrate GTA 6 Launch
cn_title: Rockstar总裁Sam Houser罕见发表声明，庆祝《GTA6》发售
opus_summary: 随着《GTA6》在全球发售，Rockstar总裁兼联合创始人Sam Houser罕见发表声明，表示希望游戏超越玩家期待，并期待在未来许多年继续分享游戏体验。Rockstar尚未讨论下一代《GTA Online》。

paragraphs.en: As GTA 6 launches around the world, Rockstar president and co-founder Sam Houser has issued a rare statement to celebrate the occasion and "many more years" of experiences ahead.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》在全球发售，Rockstar总裁兼联合创始人Sam Houser罕见发表声明，庆祝这一时刻以及未来「许多年」的体验。

paragraphs.en: While other high-ranking Rockstar staff have discussed GTA 6 in interviews thus far, the famously reclusive producer has now outlined his company's intentions with the game, and suggested there was much more to come in future.
paragraphs.cn: 此前，Rockstar的其他高层人员曾在采访中谈及《GTA6》，而这位以深居简出著称的制作人如今阐述了公司制作这款游戏的意图，并暗示未来还有更多内容。

paragraphs.en: "Rockstar Games was founded on the belief that games could achieve the same distinction as all other forms of storytelling, become essential to modern culture, and to be thought of as stories and worlds that live on with all of us," Houser began, in a statement shared with IGN's GTA 6 reviewer, Luke Reilly .
paragraphs.cn: Houser在一份与IGN《GTA6》评测者Luke Reilly分享的声明中开篇写道：「Rockstar成立时秉持着这样的信念：游戏能够达到与其他所有叙事形式同等的卓越水准，成为现代文化不可或缺的一部分，并被视为与我们所有人共同延续的故事和世界。」

paragraphs.en: "This week, Grand Theft Auto returns to Leonida and modern-day Vice City. While things have changed and time has passed, one aspect holds true: We have tried to create an experience that will exceed your expectations while showing what this medium is capable of, and why we believe games are so special.
paragraphs.cn: 「本周，《侠盗猎车手》将重返Leonida和现代的Vice City。尽管事物已然改变，时光也已流逝，但有一点始终不变：我们努力创造一种超越你们期待的体验，同时展现这一媒介的潜力，以及我们为何相信游戏如此特别。

paragraphs.en: "Whether you can trace your journey to this game through the entire series or are experiencing Grand Theft Auto for the first time, this is a narrative set in a world full of possibilities — and it is up to you as the player to shape how it ultimately feels, and concludes.
paragraphs.cn: 「无论你是一路玩过整个系列来到这款游戏，还是第一次体验《侠盗猎车手》，这都是一个发生在充满可能性的世界中的故事——而这个故事最终给人怎样的感受、如何收尾，都由身为玩家的你来塑造。

paragraphs.en: "We hope it felt both familiar and entirely new, and above all, we hope that you had fun. We are incredibly grateful to you and everything that you do to celebrate games. We look forward to many more years of sharing these experiences with you.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们希望它既让你感到熟悉，又让你觉得焕然一新；最重要的是，我们希望你玩得开心。我们无比感谢你，以及你为庆祝游戏所做的一切。我们期待在未来许多年里继续与你分享这些体验。

paragraphs.en: While Houser's rare statement is notable enough on its own, the mention of "many more years" of experiences from Rockstar will inevitably excite fans already wondering what's next from the company. While the base GTA 6 offers hundreds of hours of experiences to discover and enjoy, there is of course huge speculation surrounding the game's unannounced but inevitable online portion. As of yet, Rockstar has not discussed its next iteration of GTA Online at all, though fans expect to hear something of it sooner or later.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Houser这份罕见的声明本身就足够引人注目，但其中提及Rockstar未来「许多年」的体验，无疑会让已经在好奇公司下一步动向的粉丝兴奋不已。虽然《GTA6》本体提供了数百小时可供探索和享受的体验，但围绕游戏尚未公布、却不可避免会推出的线上部分，自然也有大量猜测。截至目前，Rockstar完全没有谈及下一版《GTA Online》，不过粉丝们预计迟早会听到相关消息。

paragraphs.en: The current GTA 5 version of GTA Online has raked in around $5 billion so far since its arrival back in 2013. Another version seems less a matter of if rather than when, though exactly how it will differ, and what will become of the existing service all remains under wraps.
paragraphs.cn: 目前基于《GTA5》的《GTA Online》自2013年推出以来，至今已揽入约50亿美元。另一个版本似乎与其说是会不会推出的问题，不如说是何时推出的问题，不过它具体会有何不同，以及现有服务将何去何从，仍未披露。

paragraphs.en: IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.
paragraphs.cn: IGN提供了《GTA6》发售所需的一切信息，包括《GTA6》的全球发售时间，以及你需要下载的临时PS5更新的详情。如果你错过了这条消息，昨晚我们得知了《GTA6》中Lucia的现实身份。我们的《GTA6》发售直播博客现已上线，接下来几个小时里，我们会通过它向你介绍有关这款游戏的其他所有信息。
